title: Department of Veterans Affairs decision letter (21 October 2015)
citation: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, decision letter to Larry D. Hunnewell, 21 October 2015. Family copy, scanned August 2026.
notes: Scanned 2026-08-15 in the same file as the clear copy of the DD-214, and kept in the family's private archive. Research value: it carries his VA file number, used on the records request, and points to his VA claims file, which can hold copies of service records the VA gathered; that file has not been requested.
